title: Civil War: Battle of Petersburg
description:
Civil War: Battle of Petersburg is a turn-based tactical wargame focused on the fighting around Richmond and Petersburg during the final year of the American Civil War.

Originally released in 2017, the game has been extensively rebuilt and expanded for modern systems while preserving the fast and accessible hex-based warfare of the original.

Command infantry, cavalry, artillery and generals across a detailed historical battlefield. Use terrain, positioning, concentrated fire and flanking attacks to break the enemy line.

The rules are easy to understand, but every battlefield presents a different tactical problem.

Four Historical BattlesThe base game includes the four original historical scenarios:

• Battle of the Crater

• Bermuda Hundred

• New Market Heights

• Cold Harbor / Richmond

Each battle features historically inspired formations, terrain and objectives built around the historical Petersburg battlefield map.

Play them individually and master each engagement across multiple difficulty levels.

Tactical Turn-Based CombatEvery formation has a limited number of movement and combat actions each turn.

Success depends on how you use them.

• Maneuver infantry through favorable terrain

• Position artillery to dominate important approaches

• Use cavalry to threaten exposed flanks

• Protect your general

• Exploit weakened enemy formations

• Attack from behind for a +40% flanking bonus

• Decide when to advance and when to preserve your forces

Battles are designed to move quickly without sacrificing tactical depth.

Two Ways to View the BattlefieldSwitch instantly between two complementary battlefield views.

Classic ViewExperience the battlefield from the distinctive tabletop perspective of the original game, with upright formations and a cinematic view across the historical map.

Tactical ViewMove to a clearer command-oriented battlefield view designed for quickly reading formations, terrain and objectives.

Change views at any time during battle.

Significantly Improved Battlefield AICompared to the original 2017 release, the battlefield AI has been substantially improved to provide a more challenging, believable and tactically varied opponent.

Enemy forces now make much better use of:

• Battlefield objectives

• Defensive terrain

• Artillery positioning

• Flanking opportunities

• Local counterattacks

• Reserve formations

• Vulnerable or isolated units

• Withdrawal and defensive situations

Rather than simply advancing toward the nearest target, the AI evaluates the developing battle and reacts to threats, opportunities and changing objectives.

Higher difficulty levels increase the challenge further through stronger positioning, more aggressive tactical decisions and more demanding battlefield situations.

The result is a far more capable and responsive opponent, while preserving the fast turn-based flow of the original game.

Play Against Other CommandersBattle another player locally or across a network.

Multiplayer modes include:

• Online Versus

• LAN

• Hotseat

• Play by Email

Host private matches with friends or create public battles for other players to join.

Configurable turn timers, in-match communication and AI takeover for abandoned battles help keep longer engagements practical to play.

Scenario EditorCreate your own Civil War battles with the built-in Scenario Editor.

Design battlefields, place formations, define objectives and build scenarios using the same tactical systems as the official battles.

Share your creations through Steam Workshop, browse community scenarios and build anything from historical engagements to completely original battles.

Community-created scenarios can be played by anyone who owns the base game, with no additional DLC required.

Built for ReplayabilityCivil War: Battle of Petersburg can be played your way.

• Historical single-player battles

• Significantly improved battlefield AI

• Multiple difficulty levels

• Classic and Tactical battlefield views

• Online multiplayer

• LAN

• Hotseat

• Play by Email

• Scenario Editor

• Steam Workshop

• Steam achievements and leaderboards

• Steam Cloud

Whether you want a quick historical battle, a demanding tactical challenge, a long match against another commander or a scenario of your own creation, the same battlefield system supports them all.

Expand the Petersburg CampaignTwo optional Grand Campaign expansions add 15 missions each, persistent armies, headquarters management, historical formations, equipment, supplies and new battle objectives.

Union Grand CampaignLead Grant's armies through the expanding siege, cut the Confederate supply routes and carry the campaign through to the final breakthrough at Petersburg.

Confederate Grand CampaignDefend Richmond and Petersburg, raid Union supply lines, preserve increasingly scarce forces and fight through the final Confederate withdrawal.

Both Grand Campaign DLCs also unlock their official historical scenarios for individual Single Battle play.

Take command. Read the battlefield. Break the enemy line.
description_short: Command Union or Confederate forces near Petersburg and Richmond in 1864. Fight for a nation divided. Massively updated in 2026 with online multiplayer, 3D battlefield units, improved AI, and a powerful Scenario Editor for creating and sharing your own battles.
